style_line: Flanders, Christmas 1914, a frozen winter world.

location.where_when: No man's land between the lines / Boxing Day 1914, morning

landmarks.text: rows of barbed wire on wooden stakes
a ruined brick farm in the distance
fresh graves with small wooden crosses

light.colour_key: pale white winter dawn, flat grey midday, low amber sunset

char_friedrich_brandt.name: the Saxon corporal
char_friedrich_brandt.description: Gefreiter Friedrich Brandt, a broad-shouldered 32-year-old Saxon soldier with a calm square face, close-cropped dark-blond hair, a full fair moustache, kind tired eyes, a field-grey round Feldmuetze cap with red band and cockade, field-grey 1907 tunic, grey greatcoat, black leather belt and boots

costumes.field: field-grey round cap with red band, grey greatcoat buttoned, the portrait card in the left breast pocket
costumes.button_given: field-grey round cap with red band, grey greatcoat buttoned with one button missing, the portrait card in the left breast pocket

char_thomas_hale.name: the young British private
char_thomas_hale.description: Private Thomas Hale, a lean 20-year-old English infantryman with a pale freckled face, short sandy-brown hair, light grey eyes, a khaki 1914 soft service cap with ear flaps, khaki 1902 service-dress tunic with brass buttons, 1908 webbing, muddy puttees, a long khaki greatcoat

costumes.service: khaki soft cap, long khaki greatcoat open over the tunic, every brass tunic button in place
costumes.button_cut: khaki soft cap, long khaki greatcoat open over the tunic, the top right brass tunic button cut off

characters.action: Friedrich stands facing Thomas in the fog

changes.cause: a new set-up (MS, eyeline): Thomas faces Friedrich
